mapper.select: SELECT id,number,note,fingerprint,published_by,created_at FROM agent_version WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) ORDER BY number DESC
SELECT * FROM agent_version WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) AND id=CAST(#{version} AS uuid)
SELECT v.* FROM agent_publication p JOIN agent_version v ON v.id=p.version_id WHERE p.agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid)
SELECT server_id::text FROM agent_mcp_grant WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) ORDER BY server_id
SELECT kb_id::text FROM agent_knowledge_base WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agent} AS uuid) ORDER BY kb_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_version(id,agent_id,number,note,snapshot,fingerprint,published_by) VALUES(CAST(#{version} AS uuid),CAST(#{agent} AS uuid),#{number},#{note}, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb),#{fingerprint},CAST(#{author} AS uuid))
INSERT INTO agent_publication(agent_id,version_id) VALUES(CAST(#{agent} AS uuid),CAST(#{version} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT(agent_id) DO UPDATE SET version_id=EXCLUDED.version_id
